2. aos-slack — high workflow/event relevance and good read-only coverage for channels/users/search.
Service keys: SLACK_BOT_TOKEN required; SLACK_TEAM_ID, SLACK_CHANNEL_ID, SLACK_USER_ID preferred. SLACK_APP_TOKEN only if an assigned smoke explicitly covers socket/app-token setup.
Commands: cd tools/aos/aos-slack/agent-harness && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'; aos-slack --json --mode readonly health; aos-slack --json --mode readonly doctor; aos-slack --json --mode readonly config show; aos-slack --json --mode readonly channel list --limit 10; aos-slack --json --mode readonly people list --limit 10; aos-slack --json --mode readonly message search --query '<operator-approved-safe-query>' --limit 5; aos-slack --json --mode readonly mention scan --limit 5.
Risk/downgrade: missing scopes such as users:read/search can make capability claims permission-limited. If channel/user/search reads fail, mark affected commands read-only permission-limited and do not trust message.reply readiness. Do not run message.reply.

3. aos-teams — enterprise collaboration connector; read-only smoke proves Graph tenant/app permissions before writes.
Service keys: TEAMS_TENANT_ID, TEAMS_CLIENT_ID, TEAMS_CLIENT_SECRET required; TEAMS_TEAM_ID and TEAMS_USER_ID preferred; optional TEAMS_CHANNEL_ID, TEAMS_CHAT_ID.
Commands: cd tools/aos/aos-teams/agent-harness && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'; aos-teams --json --mode readonly health; aos-teams --json --mode readonly doctor; aos-teams --json --mode readonly config show; aos-teams --json --mode readonly team list --limit 10; aos-teams --json --mode readonly channel list --team-id "$TEAMS_TEAM_ID" --limit 10; aos-teams --json --mode readonly meeting list --user-id "$TEAMS_USER_ID" --limit 10.
Risk/downgrade: Graph app consent is the likely blocker. If list/read surfaces fail, keep live writes deferred/permission-limited. Do not run channel.create or meeting.create.

4. aos-n8n — direct automation bridge; read-only workflow list/status validates the API bridge before trigger writes.
Service keys: N8N_API_URL, N8N_API_KEY required; N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL optional unless later testing trigger paths.
Commands: cd tools/aos/aos-n8n/agent-harness && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'; aos-n8n --json --mode readonly health; aos-n8n --json --mode readonly doctor; aos-n8n --json --mode readonly config show; aos-n8n --json --mode readonly workflow list --limit 10; aos-n8n --json --mode readonly workflow status <operator-provided-workflow-id> OR aos-n8n --json --mode readonly workflow status --status active.
Risk/downgrade: without a tenant/workflow id, only config/auth and list can be proven. If list/status fail, downgrade trigger readiness to preview-only/read-unverified. Do not run workflow.trigger.

Service keys: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN required; HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID preferred.
Commands: cd tools/aos/aos-hubspot/agent-harness && python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly health; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly doctor; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly config show; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly owner list --limit 10; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly pipeline list --object-type deal; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly contact list --limit 10; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly company list --limit 10; aos-hubspot --json --mode readonly deal list --limit 10.

subject: Hermes skill loading comparison matrix
body:
LANE LOCK:
Repo: ArgentAIOS/argentos-core
Local path: /Users/sem/code/argent-core/worktrees/hermes-skill-loading
Target branch: dev
Forbidden repo for this task: ArgentAIOS/argentos
Reason: core agent skill loading/discovery work

Task: task-20260427175158-desyvc
Branch/worktree for analysis: codex/hermes-skill-loading at origin/dev d1314be9
Code edits: none

Hermes skill loading comparison matrix:

1. Catalog breadth/layout
Hermes behavior: active profile skills are organized as categorized SKILL.md trees with category DESCRIPTION.md files; Excalidraw lives under creative and describes diagrams/flowcharts/architecture/visualization in frontmatter tags and body.
Current Argent behavior: origin/dev includes 77 skills/hermes/** and 77 neutral skills/community/** plus 75 top-level bundled skills. Argent prompt rendering groups by category and includes category descriptions.
Gap: catalog import is present, but both hermes-* and community-* copies can be visible, increasing duplicate choices and prompt noise unless filtered by config or source policy.
Recommended bounded fix: prefer the neutral community catalog for model-visible prompt entries when an equivalent Hermes-imported skill exists; keep legacy Hermes entries installed but mark them non-preferred/model-hidden or de-duplicate by upstream_import/hermes_import original_name + category.
Risk: hiding too aggressively could remove a workspace override. Keep precedence workspace > managed > community > hermes and only de-dupe bundled upstream twins.
Verification path: add skills snapshot tests proving community-excalidraw remains visible while hermes-excalidraw duplicate is suppressed only when both are bundled/import twins.

2. Match/routing behavior
Hermes behavior: feels intent-first: a user asks for a diagram/flowchart and the Excalidraw or diagram skill is loaded immediately, even when phrasing is not an exact skill name.
Current Argent behavior: matchSkillCandidatesForPrompt tokenizes the user prompt and overlaps against skill name, description, primaryEnv, and filePath only. It ignores metadata tags/related skills and has no alias/fuzzy phrase handling for transcript variants like XcaliDraw/exit draw or broad requests like hand-drawn diagram.
Gap: imported skills have useful metadata tags, but the matcher does not use them; near-miss voice transcripts can miss candidate surfacing on the first turn.
Recommended bounded fix: extend the skill matcher haystack to include frontmatter metadata strings and category descriptions, plus a tiny alias table for high-value skill concepts: excalidraw/xcalidraw/exit draw, flow chart/flowchart, hand-drawn diagram, architecture diagram.
Risk: overmatching broad words like diagram could surface multiple skills. Keep scoring additive but bounded, and require either alias phrase hit or normal token overlap.
Verification path: focused tests in src/agents/skills.resolveskillspromptforrun.test.ts for “Create an Excalidraw-style architecture diagram”, “exit draw flow chart”, and a non-diagram control prompt.

3. Prompt rendering/selection pressure
Hermes behavior: the system appears to place the relevant skill directly in the agent’s path; the agent behaves as if the skill shortlist is what matters now.
Current Argent behavior: buildSkillsSection tells the model to scan all <available_skills> and read one if partially relevant. Separately, the runtime emits lifecycle skill_candidates, but those candidates are not injected back into the system prompt as a top-of-turn shortlist.
Gap: Argent has candidate detection, but it is mostly observability; the model still has to search a large catalog itself.
Recommended bounded fix: add a compact <suggested_skills> block before <available_skills> when matchedSkillCandidates is non-empty, with name/source/reason/location for top 1-3 candidates. This is not auto-execution; it biases the mandatory skill-read instruction toward the shortlist.
Risk: a bad candidate could bias the model. Mitigate by limiting to top candidates, preserving the full available catalog, and wording as “review these first; if clearly wrong, choose another skill.”
Verification path: system prompt/report tests showing suggested skill block appears for matched candidates and does not appear when no matches exist.

4. Skill loading UX indicator
Hermes behavior: user perceives a skill is being looked at/loaded during the turn.
Current Argent behavior: dashboard receives lifecycle phase skill_candidates and saves matchedSkills onto the assistant message; ChatPanel renders badges after the assistant message exists. The active loading row only shows model/tool, not matched skill review.
Gap: during thinking/loading, there is no visible badge that skill candidates are being reviewed.
Recommended bounded fix: pass matchedSkills through activeModelInfo in App/ChatPanel and show a small pulsing “Workspace Skill: <name>” badge in the loading row when skill_candidates arrives.
Risk: UI could imply the skill was fully read when it was only selected as a candidate. Label as “Reviewing skill” or “Skill candidate” until a separate read event exists.
Verification path: dashboard typecheck/touched-file lint plus a focused component/manual browser smoke with a mocked skill_candidates event.

5. Actual skill-read proof
Hermes behavior: the visible experience suggests the skill is loaded, but the real proof is the agent reading SKILL.md.
Current Argent behavior: lifecycle exposes candidates, not actual SKILL.md read/use. Final matched-skill badge can imply usage even if the model never read the file.
Gap: candidate vs actual use is conflated.
Recommended bounded fix: do not claim “used” from candidate events. Short term, badge says “matched/reviewing”. Medium term, instrument read-tool calls whose path equals candidate SKILL.md and emit skill_loaded once the file is actually read.
Risk: read-tool instrumentation can cross tool boundaries; keep first slice to wording/active indicator and propose instrumentation separately.
Verification path: unit test lifecycle mapping; later integration test with a read SKILL.md path emits skill_loaded.

Recommended first implementation slice, if assigned:
Owned files:
- src/agents/skills/workspace.ts
- src/agents/skills.resolveskillspromptforrun.test.ts
- src/agents/pi-embedded-runner/run/attempt.ts
- src/agents/system-prompt-report.test.ts or focused prompt-report coverage as needed
- dashboard/src/App.tsx
- dashboard/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx
No package/update/release, AppForge, Workflows runtime/UI, AOS, OpenClaw, schema/migration, or installer files.

Slice contents:
1. Add metadata/category/alias-aware skill candidate matching.
2. Add <suggested_skills> prompt block from top candidates.
3. Add active loading badge labeled as reviewing/matched skill, not “used”.
4. Tests for Excalidraw/flowchart matching and prompt injection.

Proposed verification:
- pnpm vitest run src/agents/skills.resolveskillspromptforrun.test.ts src/agents/system-prompt.test.ts src/agents/system-prompt-report.test.ts
- pnpm exec oxlint --type-aware src/agents/skills/workspace.ts src/agents/skills.resolveskillspromptforrun.test.ts src/agents/pi-embedded-runner/run/attempt.ts dashboard/src/App.tsx dashboard/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx

subject: BUSINESS RESEARCH: licensing and Core overlay contract
body:
BUSINESS RESEARCH: licensing and Core overlay contract

LANE LOCK:
Repo: ArgentOS-Business private overlay scaffold
Local path: /Users/sem/code/ArgentOS-Business
Legacy source: /Users/sem/code/ArgentOS-Legacy
Core context: /Users/sem/code/argent-core
Task: task-20260428021514-f2p3tc
Status: read-only/design-first research complete. No Core edits, no file moves, no push, no build-clean claim.

1. Licensing and entitlement activation flow
Recommended flow:
- Core remains installed first and exposes only neutral Business status/activation APIs: business.status, business.activate, business.sync, business.disable.
- Operator enters active Business license key in Core dashboard/CLI.
- Core entitlement client sends key + machine/device identity to licensing server.
- Licensing server returns active/inactive status, org id/name, entitlement list, expiry/grace window, overlay artifact coordinate, overlay manifest hash/signature, and optional update channel.
- Core stores entitlement state outside the Business package, recommended ~/.argentos/entitlements/business.json, plus minimal cached status in config for UI.
- Only after active entitlement and verified overlay manifest does Core load Business registration.

Current evidence:
- Business scaffold has src/licensing/client.ts, manager.ts, storage.ts, secret-sync.ts. Existing manager supports activate, validate, deactivate, offline grace, and org secret sync.
- Current implementation stores encrypted license in config. Older legacy path also used ~/.argentos/license.json and marketplace check. This should be consolidated into one entitlement store owned by Core, with Business-private secret sync staying in overlay.

2. Private overlay install/update mechanism
Recommended runtime shape:
- Source repo: /Users/sem/code/ArgentOS-Business for development.
- Installed overlay: ~/.argentos/overlays/business.
- Entitlement cache: ~/.argentos/entitlements/business.json.
- Overlay manifest: business-overlay.json at overlay root.

Install/update sequence:
- Core validates license and receives package URL/private repo coordinate plus signed manifest hash.
- Core downloads or dev-links the overlay into a staging dir under ~/.argentos/overlays/.staging/business-<version>.
- Core verifies manifest id, requiredCoreVersion, entitlement requirements, artifact hash/signature, and entrypoint path.
- Core atomically flips ~/.argentos/overlays/business to the verified version.
- argent update updates Core for everyone; if Business entitlement is active, it also checks overlay updates. Expired entitlement disables overlay but does not delete local overlay data.

3. Core extension points needed
Core needs one stable overlay contract, not ad hoc optional imports:
- Manifest schema: id, version, requiredCoreVersion, entitlement keys, entrypoint, tools, gatewayHandlers, dashboardPanels/routes/widgets, migrations, docs, health checks, permissions.
- Entitlement service: validate/sync/disable/status with offline grace and explicit failure states.
- Overlay manager: discover, verify, stage, enable, disable, update, health-check, and provide active overlay registry.
- Tool registry extension: Business returns tool descriptors/factories; Core registers only after active entitlement. Public Core blocked names remain blocked unless active overlay overrides through entitlement.
- Gateway handler extension: Business registers method handlers such as jobs.*, execution.worker.*, intent.*, copilot.* through a method namespace contract. Core must reject duplicate/unauthorized methods.
- Execution worker provider: Core keeps disabled ExecutionWorkerRunner contract; Business supplies implementation only when active.
- Dashboard extension registry: Business contributes panel/widget metadata and asset entrypoints. Core dashboard fetches registry/status and renders loaded overlay surfaces without bundling Business source in public Core.
- Migration runner: Core exposes overlay migration API with idempotent SQL files, applied-migration ledger, dry-run/status, and rollback/disable semantics limited to disabling code, not dropping customer data.
- OSDocs registry: os_docs currently resolves one local docs directory. It needs overlay docs roots when entitlement is active so Business docs become searchable only for enabled Business installs.

4. Security boundaries
Core can know:
- License status category, org id/name, entitlement names, expiry/grace state, overlay version, signed manifest hash, health state.
- Public-safe Business concepts: Business overlay exists, install/update/status, active/expired/inactive.

Private overlay keeps:
- Worker runner implementation, workforce/job orchestration internals, governance policies and simulation packs, org secret sync implementation, private registry/package coordinates beyond signed artifact metadata, Business dashboard code, Business docs internals.

Failure behavior:
- Missing license: Core stays fully usable, Business inactive, no Business imports.
- Invalid/revoked/expired outside grace: disable Business tools/routes/runners, stop active Business sidecars cleanly, keep local data, show clear status.
- License server unreachable: allow only if within cached offline grace; otherwise disable Business after grace, Core unaffected.
- Signature/hash mismatch: fail closed, do not load overlay, retain previous verified overlay if still entitled and within policy.
- Business route/tool calls when inactive: return unavailable/not_entitled without exposing private implementation details.

5. Migration strategy for Business tables/workforce/governance
Business data currently lives inside legacy shared storage code. Extract as overlay migrations, not whole Core storage files.
- Create business migration 001_workforce_jobs.sql for job_templates, job_assignments, job_runs, job_events and task linkage columns/indexes if Core contract permits task annotations.
- Create business migration 002_workflow_approvals.sql for approval_status, approved_by, approval_note, edited_output if approval nodes stay Business-only.
- Keep data on expiry/disable; disabling Business must not drop tables.
- Migrations must be idempotent and recorded in a Core-owned overlay_migrations ledger keyed by overlay id/version/migration id.
- Storage adapter contract needed: Business code should receive a Core database handle or narrow storage services, not import src/data/pg-adapter.ts.

6. Compile/test plan to make scaffold build-clean
Current scaffold is not build-clean. Main blockers are legacy relative imports into Core modules such as config, data, agents, gateway protocol, logging, hooks, service-keys, dashboard hooks/utils, and IntentConfig types.
Plan:
- Define @argentos/core-extension-api package or exported Core contract surface with types/services for config, logging, storage, gateway handlers, tools, dashboard registration, docs, migrations, execution worker.
- Replace relative imports in Business with contract imports.
- Split Business package into runtime TS and dashboard TS build targets.
- Add package scripts: typecheck, test, lint/format, manifest validation.

subject: BUSINESS SPEC: Core overlay contract
body:
BUSINESS SPEC: Core overlay contract

LANE LOCK:
Repo: ArgentOS-Business private overlay scaffold
Local path: /Users/sem/code/ArgentOS-Business
Legacy source: /Users/sem/code/ArgentOS-Legacy
Core context: /Users/sem/code/argent-core
Task: task-20260428022259-gm676i
Status: implementation-ready contract spec, read-only/design-only. No Core edits, no file moves, no push, no build-clean claim.

1) business-overlay.json schema proposal
Required fields:
- schemaVersion: integer, start at 1.
- id: stable lowercase id, e.g. argentos-business. Must match /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$/.
- name: human display name.
- version: semver string.
- requiredCoreVersion: semver range.
- entitlements: non-empty string array, e.g. [business].
- entrypoint: relative path inside overlay package to runtime registration module.
- signature: object in production installs: algorithm, keyId, manifestDigest, artifactDigest, signature.
- surfaces: object declaring tools, gatewayMethods, dashboard, docs, migrations, healthChecks.

Optional fields:
- channel: stable|dev|canary.
- build: commit, builtAt, sourceRepo, sourceRef.
- permissions: requested capabilities: storage, gatewayMethods, dashboardAssets, orgSecretSync, networkHosts, filesystemRoots.
- compatibility: minNodeVersion, supportedPlatforms, featureFlags.
- dev: localSourcePath, allowUnsigned boolean, only honored when Core dev mode is explicitly enabled.

Validation rules:
- Manifest paths must be relative, normalized, no .. segments, no absolute paths, no symlinks escaping overlay root.
- version and requiredCoreVersion must parse before any code load.
- id must equal entitlement payload overlay id.
- Every declared gateway method/tool/dashboard route must use an approved namespace/prefix.
- Production overlays require signature/hash verification before entrypoint import.
- Entitlement mismatch means discoverable status only; do not import entrypoint.

2) @argentos/core-extension-api TypeScript interface proposal
Package/module: @argentos/core-extension-api, exported by Core and used by Business.

Core types:
- OverlayManifest: parsed manifest schema above.
- OverlayRegistration: returned by Business entrypoint.
- OverlayContext: services Core passes into register(ctx).
- EntitlementSnapshot: status, org, entitlements, expiresAt, graceEndsAt, lastValidatedAt.
- CoreLogger: debug/info/warn/error with structured metadata.
- CoreConfigService: read, patch, subscribe, redacted reads for dashboard.
- CoreStorageService: narrow query/transaction/migration handle; no direct pg-adapter import.
- CoreToolRegistry: registerTool(factory, metadata, entitlement).
- CoreGatewayRegistry: registerHandlers(namespace, handlers, entitlement).
- CoreDashboardRegistry: registerPanel, registerWidget, registerRoute, asset manifest reference.
- CoreDocsRegistry: registerDocsRoot(root, visibility, entitlement).
- CoreMigrationRegistry: registerMigrations({ overlayId, version, migrations }).
- ExecutionWorkerProviderRegistry: registerExecutionWorkerRunner(factory).
- HealthCheckRegistry: registerHealthCheck(id, fn).
- SecretService: org secret sync/upsert contract with no overwrite-manual default.

Business entrypoint shape:
export function registerOverlay(ctx: OverlayContext): OverlayRegistration | Promise<OverlayRegistration>;

OverlayRegistration fields:
- id, version.
- teardown(): Promise<void> | void.
- healthChecks: ids declared/registered.
- registeredSurfaces summary for status UI.

Do not allow Business to import Core internals such as ../config/config.js, ../data/pg-adapter.js, ../gateway/protocol/index.js, ../logging/subsystem.js. It must import only @argentos/core-extension-api plus normal dependencies.

3) business.status / activate / sync / disable gateway contract
Namespace: business.*. These live in Core and never import Business code directly.

business.status request: {}
Response:
- installed: boolean
- enabled: boolean
- entitlement: { status: none|active|expired|revoked|invalid|grace|unreachable, orgId?, orgName?, expiresAt?, graceEndsAt?, lastValidatedAt? }
- overlay: { id?, version?, path?, manifestDigest?, updateAvailable?, health?: ok|degraded|failed|not_loaded }
- migrations: { pending: number, applied: number, failed?: string[] }
- reason?: string

business.activate request:
- licenseKey: string
- devOverlayPath?: string, dev-only
- channel?: stable|dev|canary
Response:
- ok: boolean
- status: same shape as business.status
- nextAction?: none|restart_required|migration_required|manual_review
- error?: BusinessError

business.sync request:
- force?: boolean
- includeOverlayUpdate?: boolean default true
Response:
- ok, status, sync: { entitlementChecked, overlayChecked, updated, previousVersion?, newVersion? }, error?

business.disable request:
- reason?: user|expired|revoked|debug
- keepData?: boolean default true; false forbidden until explicit destructive task
Response:
- ok, status, stoppedSurfaces: string[]

Failure codes:
- BUSINESS_NO_LICENSE
- BUSINESS_LICENSE_INVALID
- BUSINESS_LICENSE_EXPIRED
- BUSINESS_LICENSE_REVOKED
- BUSINESS_LICENSE_SERVER_UNREACHABLE
- BUSINESS_OFFLINE_GRACE_EXPIRED
- BUSINESS_OVERLAY_NOT_INSTALLED
- BUSINESS_OVERLAY_SIGNATURE_INVALID
- BUSINESS_OVERLAY_MANIFEST_INVALID
- BUSINESS_OVERLAY_CORE_INCOMPATIBLE
- BUSINESS_OVERLAY_LOAD_FAILED
- BUSINESS_MIGRATION_FAILED
- BUSINESS_PERMISSION_DENIED

4) overlay install/update state machine
States:
- absent: no entitlement, no installed overlay.
- inactive: entitlement absent/invalid; overlay may exist but is not loaded.
- entitled: valid entitlement, no verified overlay loaded yet.
- staging: artifact/dev path being copied/linked into ~/.argentos/overlays/.staging/business-<version>.
- verifying: manifest/schema/signature/hash/core-version checked.
- ready: verified overlay on disk but not imported.
- migrating: idempotent migrations running.
- enabled: entrypoint loaded and surfaces registered.
- degraded: loaded but health check or migration warning exists.
- disabled: operator/license disabled; data retained.
- failed: verification/load/migration failure; previous verified version may remain active.

Transitions:
- absent -> entitled via activate with active license.
- entitled -> staging -> verifying -> ready -> migrating -> enabled.
- enabled -> staging -> verifying -> ready -> migrating -> enabled for update.
- enabled -> disabled on expired/revoked/outside grace; data retained.
- verifying failed -> failed, keep previous enabled overlay if compatible and entitlement allows.
- migrating failed -> failed/degraded depending migration severity; do not partially register new surfaces.

Atomic switch:
- Download/copy to staging.
- Verify in staging.
- Write overlay install record.
- Atomic rename/symlink swap to ~/.argentos/overlays/business.
- Load after swap.

Expiration/grace:
- If server unreachable and cached active within grace, keep enabled and show grace.
- If grace expired, disable surfaces and runner; retain overlay files/data.
- Revoked/invalid disables immediately.

5) migration ledger contract
Core table: overlay_migrations
Columns:
- overlay_id text not null
- overlay_version text not null
- migration_id text not null
- checksum text not null
- description text
- applied_at timestamptz
- status text check in pending|applied|failed|skipped
- error text
- execution_ms integer
Primary key: overlay_id, migration_id.

Migration file rules:
- Path: migrations/<semver-or-sequence>_<slug>.sql, e.g. migrations/001_workforce_jobs.sql.
- Must be idempotent: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS, CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS.
- Never drop customer data in disable/expired flows.
- Destructive migrations require explicit manifest flag destructive: true and Core must refuse unless operator/Master policy enables it.
- Business tables should be prefixed or clearly owned: job_templates/job_assignments/job_runs/job_events are accepted legacy names but new tables should prefer business_* if greenfield.
- Task linkage columns on Core tables require explicit Core contract approval.

6) dashboard/operator surfaces
Core dashboard surfaces needed:
- Business status card in Settings or Operations: inactive/active/grace/expired/revoked/update available/failed.
- Activation form: license key entry, machine id display, activate button, safe errors.
- Overlay health panel: version, manifest digest, update channel, last sync, docs enabled, migrations pending/failed.
- Actions: sync now, disable Business, retry migration, open logs.
- Business dashboard registry mount points: panels, widgets, routes are metadata-fed. Core should not bundle Business source.

Business-contributed surfaces once active:
- License/org status detail panel may extend Core status but not replace Core activation safety UI.
- Workforce board, worker flow modal, worker wizard, jobs board widget, org chart widget.
- Governance/evidence/review panels after migration of those modules.

7) recommended Core first-slice files/modules for Master to assign later
First slice should be contract-only, no Business import:
- src/overlays/manifest.ts
- src/overlays/manifest.test.ts
- src/overlays/manager.ts
- src/overlays/manager.test.ts
- src/entitlements/store.ts
- src/entitlements/store.test.ts
- src/gateway/server-methods/business.ts
- src/gateway/server-methods/business.test.ts
- src/agents/docs-path.ts or new src/agents/docs-roots.ts for overlay docs roots
- src/agents/tools/os-docs-tool.test.ts for overlay docs inactive/active behavior
- docs/concepts/business-overlay.md
- docs/tools/index.md or docs nav file to include public-safe concept
Optional first-slice dashboard-only if Master wants UI: dashboard/src/lib/businessStatus.ts and minimal status card stub, but not Business panels.

8) Business import conversion map after Core contract lands
Current Business scaffold import families to convert:
- ../config/* and ../../config/* -> OverlayContext.config and exported config types.
- ../data/* and ../../data/* -> OverlayContext.storage and business storage service/types.
- ../agents/tool/common.js -> Core tool API createTool/result helpers from @argentos/core-extension-api.
- ../gateway/protocol/index.js and ./types.js -> Core gateway handler types/errors from @argentos/core-extension-api.
- ../logging/subsystem.js -> ctx.logger.
- ../hooks/internal-hooks.js -> ctx.events/internal hooks API.
- ../infra/service-keys.js -> ctx.secrets.bulkUpsert({ source: org-sync, overwriteManual: false }).
- ../agents/agent-scope.js, ../commands/agent.js, ../process/*, ../routing/session-key.js -> execution worker service API in Core contract.
- dashboard ../../hooks/useGateway and ../utils/localApiFetch -> Core dashboard extension SDK hooks.
- dashboard ../../../../src/config/types.intent imports -> exported @argentos/core-extension-api intent config types or Business-local copies if not public-safe.
- tests importing ../data/types.js, ../config/types.js, ../protocol/index.js -> test utilities from contract package.

High-risk files needing most conversion:
- src/workers/execution-worker-runner.ts
- src/workforce/job-orchestrator-runner.ts
- src/tools/workforce-setup-tool.ts
- src/governance/intent-simulation-runner.ts
- src/gateway/handlers/jobs.ts
- dashboard/worker-wizard/**

9) test matrix
Unit:
- Manifest accepts valid argentos-business manifest and rejects bad ids, absolute paths, ../ paths, incompatible semver, missing entitlements, unsigned production manifest.
- Entitlement store parses active/expired/revoked/grace/unreachable and never exposes raw key in status.
- Overlay manager discover/status does not import entrypoint when inactive.
- business.status returns inactive cleanly with no overlay present.
- business.activate handles invalid key, active key, incompatible overlay, bad signature.
- Migration ledger records applied/failed and refuses checksum drift.
- os_docs excludes Business docs when inactive and includes registered Business docs when active.

Integration:
- Mock license server returns active Business entitlement and signed dev overlay coordinate.
- Core stages/verifies dev overlay manifest without loading code before entitlement.
- Active entitlement registers mock tool/gateway/dashboard/docs/migration surfaces.
- Expired/revoked entitlement disables registered surfaces and runner while data remains.
- Update from v0.1.0 to v0.1.1 switches atomically and rolls back on load failure.

Manual smoke:
- Clean Core install with no license: Core boots, business.status inactive, no Business tools/routes/docs.
- Activate fake local dev license: status active, overlay enabled, docs visible, mock Business health ok.
- Simulate license server unreachable within grace: status grace, Business still enabled.
- Simulate grace expired: Business disabled, Core still healthy.
- Run argent update with active entitlement: Core update plus overlay update check; no overwrite of operator data.

Open questions and recommended defaults
- License API hostname: default to license.argentos.ai API for entitlement, but allow dev override via config/env.
- Raw license key storage: prefer not storing raw key after activation; store token/entitlement cache. If raw key is needed temporarily, encrypt and redact all status endpoints.
- Dashboard asset loading: default to manifest-declared built assets served from overlay static dir after verification; avoid arbitrary remote JS.
- Business docs visibility: default active-entitlement only.
- Migration ownership: default no destructive migrations, no table drops, no column drops.
- Org secret sync: default no manual-key overwrite, require explicit org entitlement.

Recommended default next action
Master should assign the Core first slice above as a contract-only implementation. Business lane should stay read-only until that lands, then convert scaffold imports against @argentos/core-extension-api and add manifest/registration tests.
